Module Contents¶

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.sge_array.sge_pesa_array_resources(stages_sel: list[str], *, device: str, project: str, account: str, queue: str | None, h_vmem_stage1: str, h_vmem_cpu: str, ngpu: int, cpu_ngpu: int) → tuple[nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources, bool]¶

Padded resources for a per-subject PESA-Fat stage1–3 array job.

Pads h_vmem to stage1 when stage1 is among stages_sel; otherwise uses the CPU-stage mem. ngpu / use_nv follow device (same as today’s per-stage behaviour when device=gpu).

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.sge_array.submit_subject_stage_array(*, subject: str, job_prefix: str, stages_sel: list[str], stage_specs: list[nvitk.cluster.sge.StageSpec], paths: nvitk.cluster.sge.ClusterPaths, resources: nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources, use_nv: bool = True, base_hold: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False, emit: TextIO | None = None, marker_dir: pathlib.Path) → list[str]¶

Submit one SGE array job for stages_sel; return [jid].

Each StageSpec is turned into a singularity shell command as one array task. Aggregate / QC callers may hold on the single returned jid.
